senses.example: A biopsy gave the definitive diagnosis.
senses.exampleCN: 活检给出了确诊。
senses.why: Medicine separates a provisional impression from a definitive diagnosis: the latter crosses the line where evidence is strong enough to fix the disease.
senses.whyCN: 医学把临时印象与确诊分开：后者越过界线，证据强到足以把疾病定下来。

senses.title: The definitive host
senses.titleCN: 终宿主：寄生虫在此完成生活史
senses.definition: in parasitology, the host in which a parasite reaches sexual maturity
senses.definitionCN: 寄生虫学中寄生虫达到性成熟的宿主
senses.example: The mosquito is the definitive host for the parasite.
senses.exampleCN: 蚊子是该寄生虫的终宿主。
senses.why: The term marks the host where the parasite's cycle reaches its final, defining stage; other hosts are intermediate because the cycle is not completed there.
senses.whyCN: 这个术语标记寄生虫生活史达到最终、决定性阶段的宿主；其他宿主只是中间宿主，因为循环不在那里完成。

senses.title: A regular postage stamp
senses.titleCN: 正式邮票：长期发行的普通票
senses.definition: in philately, a stamp issued as part of a regular series rather than a commemorative one
senses.definitionCN: 集邮中作为常规系列而非纪念票发行的邮票
senses.example: The definitive stamp remained in use for twenty years.
senses.exampleCN: 这枚正式邮票使用了二十年。
senses.why: Philately borrowed the word for the standard issue that defines the ordinary postal rate, as opposed to a special commemorative printing.
senses.whyCN: 集邮界借用这个词指定义普通邮资的常规发行票，与特别纪念票相对。

senses.title: Defining or limiting
senses.titleCN: 界定性的：给事物划出范围
senses.definition: serving to define or limit the meaning or extent of something
senses.definitionCN: 用于界定或限制某事物的意义或范围的
senses.example: The clause is definitive: it fixes the boundary of the obligation.
senses.exampleCN: 这一条款是界定性的：它确定了义务的边界。
senses.why: This is the literal sense of finis 'boundary': a definitive statement does not end a debate but draws the outline within which the terms apply.
senses.whyCN: 这是 finis“边界”的字面义：界定性陈述不是终结争论，而是画出术语适用的轮廓。

senses.title: Curative medical treatment
senses.titleCN: 根治性治疗：以治愈为目标
senses.definition: in medicine, treatment intended to cure rather than merely relieve symptoms
senses.definitionCN: 医学中指以治愈而非仅缓解症状为目标的治疗
senses.example: The patient chose definitive treatment over palliative care.
senses.exampleCN: 病人选择了根治性治疗而非姑息治疗。
senses.why: Definitive treatment is the one that settles the disease at its source, in contrast with care that only manages what cannot be removed.
senses.whyCN: 根治性治疗是从根源上解决疾病的治疗，与只能处理无法去除之病灶的照护相对。

intro.en: Definitive is definit- + -ive, from Latin definire 'to set bounds'. The root finis 'boundary, end' also gives finite, final and finish, so the word is about drawing a line.
intro.cn: definitive 是 definit- + -ive，来自拉丁 definire“划定边界”。词根 finis“边界、终点”还产生 finite、final、finish，因此这个词的核心是画线。

items.en: finis meant 'boundary, limit, end'. A field had a finis, and an argument had a point beyond which it could not go.
items.cn: finis 意为“边界、限度、终点”。田地有 finis，争论也有不能再越过的点。

items.en: definire 'to bound, limit, determine' is de- 'completely' plus finire 'to bound'. Defining something was originally drawing its outer edge.
items.cn: definire“划界、限定、确定”是 de-“完全”加 finire“划定界限”。定义某物最初就是画出它的外缘。

items.en: definitivus 'serving to determine or limit' supplied the English adjective. Its meaning moves from 'limiting' to 'finally settling'.
items.cn: definitivus“用于确定或限定的”提供英语形容词。其意义从“限定”移向“最终确定”。

items.en: English definitive appears in the 16th century, first in legal and theological writing about final decisions.
items.cn: 英语 definitive 于16世纪出现，最早见于关于最终裁决的法律与神学文本。

items.en: Medicine adopted definitive diagnosis and definitive treatment; philately adopted definitive stamp; biology adopted definitive host. Each fixes a final stage or standard issue.
items.cn: 医学采用 definitive diagnosis 与 definitive treatment；集邮采用 definitive stamp；生物学采用 definitive host。每者都固定一个最终阶段或标准发行物。

items.en: The exact first English use and the date when the philatelic sense appeared are uncertain. The deeper PIE origin of finis is a reconstruction.
items.cn: 最早的确切英语用例与集邮义出现的年代均存疑。finis 的更早印欧语来源属重构。

note.en: The first group shares the same finis root but differs in meaning; the second group contains words for finality, authority and proof.
note.cn: 第一组共享同一 finis 词根但意义不同；第二组是表示终局、权威与证明的词。

entries.definition: Clear and certain, without vagueness. It says the answer is unambiguous, not that it ends the debate.
entries.definitionCN: 清楚确定、不含糊。它说答案明确，而非终结争论。

entries.definition: The statement of a word's meaning or the sharpness of an image; the noun, not the adjective.
entries.definitionCN: 词义说明或图像清晰度；是名词，不是形容词。

entries.definition: Having limits or an end, from finis. It describes bounded quantity, not authority.
entries.definitionCN: 有界限或终点的，来自 finis。它描述有限的数量，而非权威性。

entries.definition: Settling a question by evidence; very close to sense 1, but it stresses proof rather than authority.
entries.definitionCN: 靠证据终结问题；与第 1 个义项很接近，但强调证明而非权威。

entries.definition: Accepted as reliable because of the source's standing; it stresses who speaks rather than what is shown.
entries.definitionCN: 因来源地位而被视为可靠；强调谁在说，而非展示了什么。

entries.definition: Last and not to be changed; it stresses position in a sequence, while definitive stresses settling force.
entries.definitionCN: 最后且不可更改；强调序列中的位置，而 definitive 强调定案力量。

entries.definition: Determining the result; it points to the effect on an outcome, not to completeness of evidence.
entries.definitionCN: 决定结果；指向对结局的影响，而非证据的完整性。

entries.definition: The accepted reference version or level; close to sense 2, but it does not claim to end all dispute.
entries.definitionCN: 被接受的参照版本或水平；接近第 2 个义项，但不声称终结一切争议。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real Latin morphology, fixed collocations and the finis family.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实拉丁构词、固定搭配与 finis 词族。

normal.en: finis 'boundary' + de- 'completely': to define is to draw the outer line completely, and definitive is what holds that line.
normal.cn: finis“边界”+ de-“完全”：定义就是把外线完整画出，definitive 就是守住这条线的东西。

normal.en: definitive is stronger than definite: definite means clear, definitive means authoritative and final.
normal.cn: definitive 比 definite 更强：definite 是清楚，definitive 是权威且最终。

normal.en: Learn definitive answer, definitive edition and definitive agreement; they cover proof, standard version and binding force.
normal.cn: 记住 definitive answer、definitive edition、definitive agreement；分别覆盖证明、标准版本与约束力。

normal.en: define, definite, definition, definitive and finite all share finis.
normal.cn: define、definite、definition、definitive、finite 都共享 finis。

normal.en: In medicine, definitive diagnosis is confirmed and definitive treatment aims to cure.
normal.cn: 医学中，definitive diagnosis 是确诊，definitive treatment 以治愈为目标。

abstract.en: Picture a wax seal pressed on the last line of a document, closing it for good.
abstract.cn: 想象火漆印压在文件最后一行，把它永久封住。

abstract.en: Picture a surveyor driving the final boundary post into the ground, after which the field's edge is fixed.
abstract.cn: 想象测量员把最后一根界桩打进地里，此后田地边界就固定了。

abstract.en: Picture a reference book placed on a high shelf, marked as the copy everyone else must check.
abstract.cn: 想象一本参考书被放在高层书架，标明为所有人都要核对的版本。

examples.en: The review is now the definitive account of the period.
examples.cn: 这篇综述如今是关于该时期的权威论述。

examples.en: A definitive diagnosis requires laboratory confirmation.
examples.cn: 确诊需要实验室确认。

examples.en: The treaty was definitive and could not be reopened.
examples.cn: 该条约是最终性的，不能重新谈判。

dict_mnemonic.text: “de（完全）+ fin（边界）+ itive”——把边界彻底钉死 → definitive 决定性的、权威的

root: 拉丁 definire“划定边界、确定”（de-“完全”+ finire“划界”，来自 finis“边界、终点”）；definit- 词干 + -ive“具有……性质的”。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses share one act: drawing a boundary that holds. The boundary may end an argument, fix a standard edition, bind a contract, confirm a diagnosis, or mark the final stage of a parasite.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项共享一个动作：画出并守住一条边界。这条边界可以终结争论、固定标准版本、约束合同、确认诊断，或标记寄生虫生活的最终阶段。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a seal pressed on the final line, fixing the edge of what counts.
core.cn: 核心意象：印章压在最后一行，固定“算数”的边界。

branches.en: BOUNDARY: a statement that ends dispute and a clause that defines scope both draw the line that holds.
branches.cn: 边界：终结争议的陈述与界定范围的条款，都画出守得住的线。

branches.en: STANDARD ISSUE: a definitive edition and a definitive stamp are the versions everyone afterwards treats as normal.
branches.cn: 标准发行：权威版本与正式邮票，都是此后被视为常规的版本。

branches.en: BINDING FORCE: a definitive agreement fixes the line in law, where later bargaining cannot move it.
branches.cn: 约束力：最终协议在法律上固定这条线，后来的谈判不能移动它。

branches.en: MEDICINE: definitive diagnosis crosses the evidence line; definitive treatment aims to close the disease at its source.
branches.cn: 医学：确诊越过证据线；根治性治疗旨在从根源上终结疾病。

branches.en: BIOLOGY: the definitive host is where the parasite's cycle reaches its final, defining stage.
branches.cn: 生物学：终宿主是寄生虫生活史达到最终决定阶段的宿主。

intro.en: Definitive is definit- + -ive on the Latin participle stem of definire. The suffix marks a quality; the de- and fin- parts are fossilized.
intro.cn: definitive 是 definire 拉丁分词词干 definit- 加 -ive。后缀标记性质；de- 与 fin- 已凝固。

latinIntro.en: Latin finis 'boundary, end' yields finire, definire, definitio, finitus and finalis. English keeps the family in finish, final, finite, define, definition and definitive.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 finis“边界、终点”产生 finire、definire、definitio、finitus、finalis。英语在 finish、final、finite、define、definition、definitive 中保留这个词族。

items.meaningCN: 权威的；决定性的；最终的（-ive 表性质）
items.example: The report is the definitive study of the region.
items.exampleCN: 这份报告是关于该地区的权威研究。

items.meaning: to state the exact meaning or limits
items.meaningCN: 定义；界定（de-“完全”+ finire“划界”）
items.example: The contract defines the boundary of the land.
items.exampleCN: 合同界定了这块土地的边界。

items.meaningCN: 明确的；确定的
items.example: There is no definite answer yet.
items.exampleCN: 目前还没有明确答案。

items.meaningCN: 定义；清晰度（-ion 结果名词）
items.example: The definition was too narrow.
items.exampleCN: 这个定义太窄了。

items.meaningCN: 肯定地；明确地（-ly 副词）
items.example: The plan will definitely change.
items.exampleCN: 计划肯定会改变。

items.meaning: the quality of being clear or fixed
items.meaningCN: 确定性；明确性（-ness 性质名词）
items.example: The definiteness of the rule helped the staff.
items.exampleCN: 规则的明确性对员工有帮助。

items.meaningCN: 不确定的；无限期的（in-“不”+ definite）
items.example: The project was postponed for an indefinite period.
items.exampleCN: 项目被无限期推迟。

items.meaningCN: 有限的（finis + -ite 表有界限）
items.example: The planet has finite resources.
items.exampleCN: 这颗行星的资源是有限的。

items.meaningCN: 最后的；最终的（fin- + -al）
items.example: The final decision rests with the board.
items.exampleCN: 最终决定权在董事会。

definition_zh: 故意地；蓄意地；从容地；经过斟酌地
definition_en: intentionally, or in a careful and unhurried way
core_image: 一只手在天平两端反复加减砝码后才落笔
scene: The error was made deliberately to test the alarm system.
sceneCN: 这里 deliberately 是「故意地」（第 1 个义项：有意为之）；句意：这个错误是有意造成的，为的是测试报警系统。图中可辨识物件：天平、砝码、签字笔、测试记录、报警指示灯。

pos.zh: 故意地；蓄意地；从容地；经过深思地

derivatives.zh: 故意的；从容的；仔细考虑

senses.title: On purpose
senses.titleCN: 故意地：有意为之
senses.definition: intentionally, with the act chosen rather than accidental
senses.definitionCN: 有意地，行为是选择的结果而非偶然
senses.example: The error was made deliberately to test the alarm system.
senses.exampleCN: 这个错误是有意造成的，为的是测试报警系统。
senses.why: Latin deliberare means 'to weigh well'. The adverb says the act was weighed before it was done, so it was chosen rather than stumbled into.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁 deliberare 意为“仔细权衡”。这个副词表示行为在做出前已被权衡，因此是选择的结果，而非失手。

senses.title: After careful consideration
senses.titleCN: 经过斟酌地：先想清楚再做
senses.definition: after weighing reasons, rather than on impulse
senses.definitionCN: 在权衡理由之后，而非凭冲动
senses.example: She deliberately chose the slower but safer route.
senses.exampleCN: 她经过斟酌，选择了较慢但更安全的路线。
senses.why: The scales image is literal here: reasons are placed on both sides, and the act follows only after the balance settles.
senses.whyCN: 这里的“天平”意象是字面的：理由被放在两边，只有天平停稳后行动才开始。

senses.title: Slowly and unhurriedly
senses.titleCN: 从容地：不慌不忙地做
senses.definition: at a measured, unhurried pace
senses.definitionCN: 以有节制的、不慌不忙的节奏
senses.example: He deliberately paced the room, checking every corner.
senses.exampleCN: 他不慌不忙地在房间里踱步，检查每个角落。
senses.why: Weighing takes time. The same word describes the outward pace of someone who refuses to rush, because each step is still being measured.
senses.whyCN: 权衡需要时间。同一个词也描述不愿匆忙者的外在节奏，因为每一步仍在被衡量。

senses.title: Calculatedly
senses.titleCN: 算计地：故意做出某种效果
senses.definition: in a calculated way intended to produce a particular reaction
senses.definitionCN: 以意在产生特定反应的精算方式
senses.example: The remark was deliberately provocative.
senses.exampleCN: 这句话是故意挑衅的。
senses.why: Here the weighing includes the audience: the speaker measures the likely reaction and picks the wording that will produce it.
senses.whyCN: 这里的权衡包含听众：说话者估量可能反应，并挑出能产生该反应的说法。

senses.title: In a measured manner
senses.titleCN: 有分寸地：语速与用词都受控
senses.definition: with controlled speed and choice of words
senses.definitionCN: 以受控的语速与措辞
senses.example: She spoke deliberately, pausing after each point.
senses.exampleCN: 她说话从容有度，每说一点便停顿。
senses.why: Speech can be weighed too: pauses and word choices are timed, so the manner shows that the mind is still balancing each phrase.
senses.whyCN: 言语也可以被权衡：停顿与措辞都被计时，因此这种方式显示说话者仍在为每个短语称重。

senses.title: With full knowledge, in law
senses.titleCN: 蓄意地：明知后果仍为之
senses.definition: in legal usage, with awareness of the act and its likely consequences
senses.definitionCN: 法律用法中指知道行为及其可能后果仍去做
senses.example: The court found that the damage had been deliberately caused.
senses.exampleCN: 法院认定损害是蓄意造成的。
senses.why: Law needs to separate intent from accident. Deliberately marks the point where the actor knew what the act would do and chose it anyway.
senses.whyCN: 法律需要把故意与意外分开。deliberately 标记的正是行为人知道行为后果却仍选择去做的那个点。

senses.title: Not by accident
senses.titleCN: 并非偶然：与意外相对
senses.definition: in a way that contrasts with accident or oversight
senses.definitionCN: 与意外或疏忽相对的方式
senses.example: The omission was not accidental but deliberately left out.
senses.exampleCN: 这一省略并非偶然，而是故意略去。
senses.why: The word is often used to deny accident: the speaker insists that the result came from a weighed choice, not from a slip.
senses.whyCN: 这个词常用于否认意外：说话者强调结果来自权衡后的选择，而非一时失手。

senses.title: Planned ambiguity
senses.titleCN: 有意含糊：模糊本身是设计
senses.definition: in a way that leaves meaning open by design rather than by carelessness
senses.definitionCN: 以故意留下意义空间、而非因疏忽含糊的方式
senses.example: The clause was deliberately ambiguous, so both sides could accept it.
senses.exampleCN: 这一条款有意含糊，好让双方都能接受。
senses.why: Even vagueness can be weighed: the writer measures how much each side can read into the words and leaves exactly that much open.
senses.whyCN: 连含糊也可以被权衡：作者估量双方各能从字面读出多少，并恰好留下那么多空间。

intro.en: Deliberately is deliberate + -ly, from Latin deliberare 'to weigh well'. The root libra 'scales' is the same one behind equilibrium, so the word is built on a balance.
intro.cn: deliberately 是 deliberate + -ly，来自拉丁 deliberare“仔细权衡”。词根 libra“天平”也是 equilibrium 的来源，因此这个词建立在“称重”上。

items.en: libra meant 'scales, balance' and also a unit of weight. It survives in the abbreviation lb and in the zodiac sign Libra.
items.cn: libra 意为“天平、秤”，也是重量单位。它保留在缩写 lb 与星座名 Libra 中。

items.en: deliberare 'to weigh well, consider carefully' is de- 'thoroughly' plus librare 'to weigh'. The metaphor is mental: reasons are placed on the scales.
items.cn: deliberare“仔细权衡、深思”是 de-“彻底”加 librare“称重”。这是心理隐喻：理由被放上天平。

items.en: English deliberate appears both as an adjective 'careful, intentional' and as a verb 'to consider'. The adverb deliberately follows the adjective.
items.cn: 英语 deliberate 既是形容词“审慎的、有意的”，也是动词“仔细考虑”。副词 deliberately 由形容词派生。

items.en: deliberate + -ly forms an adverb of manner that covers both the intention and the pace of an act, which is why it can mean both 'on purpose' and 'slowly'.
items.cn: deliberate + -ly 构成方式副词，同时覆盖行为的意图与节奏，因此既可表示“故意”，也可表示“缓慢”。

items.en: Legal writing adopted deliberately to mark known intent, especially in phrases such as deliberately caused or deliberately omitted.
items.cn: 法律文本采用 deliberately 标记已知意图，尤见于 deliberately caused、deliberately omitted 等短语。

items.en: The exact date of the adverb's first English use is uncertain. The deeper origin of libra is debated, and no single reconstruction is agreed.
items.cn: 该副词最早英语用例的确切年代存疑。libra 的更深来源有争议，没有公认的单一重构。

note.en: The first group shares the same root but differs in part of speech; the second contains near-synonyms that stress intent, will or method.
note.cn: 第一组共享词根但词性不同；第二组是强调意图、意志或方法的近义词。

entries.definition: An adjective meaning 'intentional or careful', or a verb meaning 'to consider'. The adverb adds the manner.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词“有意的、审慎的”，或动词“仔细考虑”。副词则补充方式。

entries.definition: The process of discussing or weighing; it names the weighing, not the manner of the resulting act.
entries.definitionCN: 讨论或权衡的过程；命名的是称重过程，而非行动方式。

entries.definition: Relating to discussion and decision-making, as in a deliberative body; it does not mean 'intentional'.
entries.definitionCN: 与讨论和决策有关的，如审议机构；不表示“故意的”。

entries.definition: With a purpose in mind; it stresses the goal, while deliberately stresses that the act was weighed.
entries.definitionCN: 带着目的地；强调目标，而 deliberately 强调行为经过权衡。

entries.definition: On purpose; close to sense 1, but it does not carry the 'careful pace' sense.
entries.definitionCN: 故意地；接近第 1 个义项，但没有“从容节奏”的义项。

entries.definition: With stubborn or unlawful intent; stronger and more negative than deliberately in legal contexts.
entries.definitionCN: 固执或违法地；在法律语境中比 deliberately 更强、更负面。

entries.definition: With awareness of what one is doing; it stresses noticing, not the prior weighing.
entries.definitionCN: 有意识地；强调察觉，而非事先权衡。

entries.definition: In an ordered, step-by-step way; close to sense 3, but it stresses system rather than choice.
entries.definitionCN: 有条不紊地；接近第 3 个义项，但强调系统而非选择。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphology, fixed collocations and the libra family.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实构词、固定搭配与 libra 词族。

normal.en: libra 'scales': to deliberate is to put reasons on a balance, and deliberately means the balance was consulted.
normal.cn: libra“天平”：deliberate 就是把理由放上天平，deliberately 意为天平已被咨询过。

normal.en: One adverb, two faces: intent ('on purpose') and pace ('unhurriedly') both come from weighing.
normal.cn: 一个副词，两张面孔：意图（“故意”）与节奏（“从容”）都来自称重。

normal.en: Learn deliberately vague, deliberately slow and deliberately provocative; these show the three main branches.
normal.cn: 记住 deliberately vague、deliberately slow、deliberately provocative；展示三个主要分支。

normal.en: deliberate, deliberation, deliberative and deliberately all keep the weighing root.
normal.cn: deliberate、deliberation、deliberative、deliberately 都保留“称重”词根。

normal.en: equilibrium shares libra: equal weights on both sides is exactly the picture of deliberation.
normal.cn: equilibrium 共享 libra：两边等重正是“斟酌”的画面。

abstract.en: Picture a hand adding and removing weights until the beam is level, then writing the decision.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手反复加减砝码，直到横梁水平，然后写下决定。

abstract.en: Picture a speaker pausing before each sentence, as if checking the balance again.
abstract.cn: 想象说话者在每句前停顿，仿佛再次核对天平。

abstract.en: Picture a contract with one clause left fuzzy on purpose, because both sides weighed what they could accept.
abstract.cn: 想象合同里有一条故意留模糊，因为双方都权衡过自己能接受什么。

examples.en: The smoke was deliberately released to test the detectors.
examples.cn: 烟雾是被故意释放的，以测试探测器。

examples.en: He deliberately kept the question open in the meeting.
examples.cn: 他在会上有意让这个问题保持开放。

examples.en: She walked deliberately along the uneven path.
examples.cn: 她沿着不平的路从容而行。

dict_mnemonic.text: “de（彻底）+ liber（天平）+ ate（做）”——把理由放到天平上彻底称过才做 → deliberately 故意地、从容地

root: 拉丁 deliberare“仔细权衡”（de-“彻底”+ librare“称重”，来自 libra“天平”）；deliberate + -ly 副词后缀。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses share one act: weighing before acting. The weighing may concern whether to act at all, how fast to move, what reaction to provoke, or how much ambiguity to leave.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项共享一个动作：行动前先权衡。权衡的内容可以是是否行动、行动多快、要引发什么反应，或要留下多少含糊。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: weights added and removed until the beam settles, then the pen moves.
core.cn: 核心意象：砝码反复加减，横梁停稳后笔才落下。

branches.en: INTENT: doing on purpose and denying accident both assert that a weighed choice, not a slip, produced the act.
branches.cn: 意图：有意为之与否认偶然，都在断言行为来自权衡后的选择，而非失手。

branches.en: CONSIDERATION AND MANNER: careful choice and measured speech are the same weighing, one internal and one audible.
branches.cn: 斟酌与方式：仔细选择与有分寸的言语，是同一次称重，一个在内，一个可听。

branches.en: PACE: slow movement is the visible sign that each step is still on the scales.
branches.cn: 节奏：缓慢的动作是每一步仍在称重上的可见迹象。

branches.en: CALCULATION: provoking a reaction and planning ambiguity both measure what the audience will do with the words.
branches.cn: 算计：挑起反应与有意含糊，都在估量受众会拿这些话做什么。

branches.en: LAW: deliberately marks the moment when the actor knew the consequence and chose the act anyway.
branches.cn: 法律：deliberately 标记行为人知道后果却仍选择去做的时刻。

intro.en: Deliberately is deliberate + -ly. The adjective comes from Latin deliberatus, the participle of deliberare, so the adverb is a Latin stem wearing two English suffixes.
intro.cn: deliberately 是 deliberate + -ly。形容词来自 deliberare 的分词 deliberatus，因此这个副词是拉丁词干披着两个英语后缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin libra 'scales' gives librare 'to weigh', deliberare 'to weigh well' and aequilibrium 'equal balance'. English keeps libra in the pound abbreviation lb and in the zodiac sign Libra.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 libra“天平”产生 librare“称重”、deliberare“仔细权衡”与 aequilibrium“平衡”。英语在磅的缩写 lb 与星座 Libra 中保留 libra。

items.meaning: intentionally, or at a measured pace
items.meaningCN: 故意地；从容地（-ly 方式副词）
items.example: The letter was deliberately left unsigned.
items.exampleCN: 这封信被故意不署名。

items.meaningCN: 有意的、审慎的；仔细考虑
items.example: The decision was deliberate, not rushed.
items.exampleCN: 这个决定经过斟酌，并不仓促。

items.meaningCN: 审议；深思（-ion 过程名词）
items.example: After long deliberation, the jury returned a verdict.
items.exampleCN: 经过长时间审议，陪审团作出裁决。

items.meaningCN: 审议性的（-ive 表性质）
items.example: The senate is a deliberative body.
items.exampleCN: 参议院是一个审议机构。

items.meaning: the quality of being intentional or unhurried
items.meaningCN: 故意；从容（-ness 性质名词）
items.example: The deliberateness of the gesture unsettled them.
items.exampleCN: 这个动作的从容让他们不安。

items.meaningCN: 平衡；均衡（aequi-“相等”+ libra“天平”）
items.example: The system returned to equilibrium.
items.exampleCN: 系统恢复到平衡。

items.meaning: the scales; a unit of weight
items.meaningCN: 天平；重量单位
items.example: The old pound sign comes from libra.
items.exampleCN: 旧的英镑符号来自 libra。

items.meaningCN: 仔细考虑；共同商议
items.example: The panel deliberated for three hours.
items.exampleCN: 专家组审议了三个小时。

items.meaning: a body that debates before deciding
items.meaningCN: 先辩论后决定的审议机构
items.example: The assembly is deliberative rather than executive.
items.exampleCN: 该机构是审议性的，而非执行性的。

latinEntries.meaning: a pair of scales; a pound

definition_zh: 示范；演示；证明；示威游行
definition_en: an act of showing how something works or is done, a proof, or a public protest
core_image: 一只手把实物举到众人眼前
scene: The teacher's demonstration of the experiment lasted ten minutes.
sceneCN: 这里 demonstration 是「演示、示范」（第 1 个义项：当众展示怎么做）；句意：老师对实验的演示持续了十分钟。图中可辨识物件：举起的烧瓶、学生围成的半圆、实验台、投影图、计时器。

pos.zh: 示范；演示；证明；示威游行；展示

derivatives.zh: 说明性的；感情外露的；指示的

senses.title: Showing how something works
senses.titleCN: 示范演示：当众做给人看
senses.definition: an act of showing how something is done or how it operates
senses.definitionCN: 展示某事如何做或如何运作的行为
senses.example: The teacher's demonstration of the experiment lasted ten minutes.
senses.exampleCN: 老师对实验的演示持续了十分钟。
senses.why: demonstrare means 'to point out, show'. The noun names the act of putting something before the eyes so that others can see how it works.
senses.whyCN: demonstrare 意为“指出、展示”。名词命名的就是把某物摆到眼前、让他人看见其如何运作的行为。

senses.title: Proof by evidence
senses.titleCN: 证明：用证据或推理摆出结论
senses.definition: a proof or the act of proving something by evidence or argument
senses.definitionCN: 通过证据或论证作出的证明
senses.example: The experiment is a demonstration of the law of conservation.
senses.exampleCN: 这个实验是对守恒定律的证明。
senses.why: Showing can be done with reasons as well as objects: a demonstration puts the evidence on display until the conclusion is visible to everyone watching.
senses.whyCN: 展示不仅可以用实物，也可以用理由：证明把证据摆出来，直到所有观看者都能看见结论。

senses.title: A public protest
senses.titleCN: 示威游行：把人聚到街面上
senses.definition: a public gathering or march expressing opposition to a policy or condition
senses.definitionCN: 公开集会或游行，表达对政策或状况的反对
senses.example: Thousands joined a peaceful demonstration outside the parliament.
senses.exampleCN: 数千人参加了议会外的和平示威。
senses.why: A protest is a demonstration of numbers: the crowd shows itself in public to make its strength visible, so 'show' becomes 'show of opposition'.
senses.whyCN: 抗议是“人数的展示”：人群公开现身，使自身力量可见，于是“展示”变为“反对的展示”。

senses.title: A product demonstration
senses.titleCN: 产品演示：销售现场的试用展示
senses.definition: a sales or promotional showing of a product in use
senses.definitionCN: 销售或推广中展示产品使用情况的活动
senses.example: The cookery demonstration attracted a large crowd.
senses.exampleCN: 烹饪演示吸引了一大群人。
senses.why: Commerce borrows the classroom model: the seller shows the object working, so the buyer can judge by seeing rather than by description.
senses.whyCN: 商业借用课堂模型：卖家展示物品如何运作，让买家靠看见而非描述来判断。

senses.title: A military show of force
senses.titleCN: 军事示威：把力量摆到边境
senses.definition: a display of military strength intended to warn or deter
senses.definitionCN: 意在警告或威慑的军事力量展示
senses.example: The fleet conducted a demonstration near the disputed islands.
senses.exampleCN: 舰队在争议岛屿附近进行了力量展示。
senses.why: Here the thing shown is capacity: the display is meant to be seen and counted, so that the other side draws a conclusion without a shot being fired.
senses.whyCN: 这里展示的是能力：陈列意在被人看见、被计算，使对方不发一枪也能得出结论。

senses.title: A teaching experiment
senses.titleCN: 教学演示实验：课堂上边做边讲
senses.definition: a practical experiment performed in class to illustrate a principle
senses.definitionCN: 课堂上为说明某原理而做的实验
senses.example: The chemistry demonstration produced a bright flame.
senses.exampleCN: 化学演示产生了明亮的火焰。
senses.why: A teaching demonstration is showing plus explaining: the principle is made visible in real time, so the students see the law rather than only hear it.
senses.whyCN: 教学演示是展示加讲解：原理被实时变得可见，让学生看见定律，而不只是听见。

senses.title: An outward show of feeling
senses.titleCN: 情感表露：把心意做出来
senses.definition: an outward expression of an emotion or attitude
senses.definitionCN: 情感或态度的外在表达
senses.example: He gave her flowers as a demonstration of affection.
senses.exampleCN: 他送她花，作为爱意的表露。
senses.why: Feelings are invisible, so people make them visible through acts. The noun extends from showing objects to showing inner states.
senses.whyCN: 情感不可见，于是人们用行动使之可见。这个名词从展示物品延伸到展示内心状态。

senses.title: A pilot or demonstration project
senses.titleCN: 示范项目：先做一个小样给人看
senses.definition: a small-scale project set up to show that an approach works before wider adoption
senses.definitionCN: 在大规模采用前，用来证明某方法可行的小规模项目
senses.example: The village became a demonstration project for solar power.
senses.exampleCN: 这个村庄成为太阳能的示范项目。
senses.why: Policy also needs showing: a pilot makes a proposal visible and testable at small scale, so decision-makers can see results before committing.
senses.whyCN: 政策也需要“展示”：试点把小规模提案变得可见、可测，让决策者在投入前看见结果。

intro.en: Demonstration is demonstrat- + -ion, from Latin demonstrare 'to point out, show'. The base monstrare also gives monster and monitor, through the idea of a sign that warns.
intro.cn: demonstration 是 demonstrat- + -ion，来自拉丁 demonstrare“指出、展示”。词基 monstrare 还通过“警示的征兆”这一观念产生 monster 与 monitor。

items.en: demonstrare 'to point out, show clearly' is de- 'completely' plus monstrare 'to show'. The literal gesture is a finger indicating a thing.
items.cn: demonstrare“指出、清楚展示”是 de-“完全”加 monstrare“展示”。其字面动作是一根手指指向某物。

items.en: demonstratio 'a pointing out, a proof' named both the physical showing and the logical one. English retains both.
items.cn: demonstratio“指出、证明”同时命名物理展示与逻辑证明。英语两者都保留。

items.en: monstrare comes from monstrum 'a divine portent', related to monere 'to warn'. A portent is a sign shown so that people will take notice. The link is generally accepted but debated in detail.
items.cn: monstrare 来自 monstrum“神兆”，与 monere“警告”相关。征兆是被展示出来、让人注意的符号。这一联系一般被接受，但细节有争议。

items.en: English demonstration appears in the 16th century, first for logical proof and public showing; the protest sense is much later.
items.cn: 英语 demonstration 于16世纪出现，最早用于逻辑证明与公开展示；示威义出现得晚得多。

items.en: The political sense developed in the 19th and 20th centuries, when crowds began to be described as demonstrating their numbers or opposition.
items.cn: 政治义在19、20世纪发展起来，人们开始用 demonstrating 描述人群展示人数或反对立场。

items.en: The precise date of the protest sense and the exact derivation of monstrum from monere are uncertain; the latter is a widely accepted reconstruction rather than a proven line.
items.cn: 示威义的确切年代，以及 monstrum 由 monere 派生的精确路径，均存疑；后者是广泛接受的重构，而非已证实的链条。

note.en: The first group shares the demonstr- stem with different endings; the second contains words for showing, proving and protesting.
note.cn: 第一组共享 demonstr- 词干但词尾不同；第二组是表示展示、证明与抗议的词。

entries.definition: The verb meaning 'to show or prove'; demonstration is the noun for the act or event.
entries.definitionCN: 意为“展示或证明”的动词；demonstration 是行为或事件的名词。

entries.definition: Serving to show or point out; also describes a person who shows feelings openly. It is not the event itself.
entries.definitionCN: 用于展示或指出的；也形容感情外露的人。它不是事件本身。

entries.definition: A person who demonstrates a product or takes part in a protest; the human agent.
entries.definitionCN: 演示产品或参加抗议的人；是施事者。

entries.definition: A public expression of disapproval; it overlaps sense 3 but can also be a written objection.
entries.definitionCN: 公开表达不满；与第 3 个义项重叠，但也可指书面异议。

entries.definition: A public display of objects or works; it shows things, not processes or proofs.
entries.definitionCN: 物品或作品的公开展出；展示的是物，而非过程或证明。

entries.definition: Evidence or argument that establishes a conclusion; it overlaps sense 2 but does not imply a public show.
entries.definitionCN: 确立结论的证据或论证；与第 2 个义项重叠，但不含公开演示之意。

entries.definition: A visible arrangement or show; it stresses visibility rather than teaching or proving.
entries.definitionCN: 可见的陈列或展示；强调可见性，而非教学或证明。

entries.definition: A setting in which something is displayed to advantage; closer to sense 4 and more promotional.
entries.definitionCN: 把某物展示得最有利的场合；更接近第 4 个义项，促销意味更强。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real Latin morphology, standard collocations and the monstrare family.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实拉丁构词、标准搭配与 monstrare 词族。

normal.en: de- 'completely' + monstrare 'show': a demonstration shows something fully, so that it can be seen and judged.
normal.cn: de-“完全”+ monstrare“展示”：demonstration 把某物完整展示出来，使人能看见并判断。

normal.en: The same noun covers a science demo, a logical proof, a street protest and a show of force: all are public showings.
normal.cn: 同一个名词覆盖科学演示、逻辑证明、街头抗议与力量展示：它们都是公开的“展示”。

normal.en: Learn product demonstration, peaceful demonstration and demonstration project; they mark three branches.
normal.cn: 记住 product demonstration、peaceful demonstration、demonstration project；标记三个分支。

normal.en: demonstrate, demonstrator, demonstrative and demonstration all keep the monstr- 'show' core.
normal.cn: demonstrate、demonstrator、demonstrative、demonstration 都保留 monstr-“展示”核心。

normal.en: monster and monitor are cousins: a portent is a sign shown to warn, and a monitor watches.
normal.cn: monster 与 monitor 是远亲：征兆是被展示来警告的符号，而 monitor 负责观察。

abstract.en: Picture a hand lifting a glass vessel above a crowd so everyone can see the reaction inside.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手把玻璃容器举到人群上方，让所有人都看见里面的反应。

abstract.en: Picture a crowd filling a square, its size itself the message being displayed.
abstract.cn: 想象人群填满广场，人数本身就是被展示的信息。

abstract.en: Picture a small village wired with solar panels, set out like a sample for others to inspect.
abstract.cn: 想象一个装上太阳能板的小村庄，像样品一样摆出来供人考察。

examples.en: The lecture included a demonstration of how the pump works.
examples.cn: 讲座包含了对泵如何运作的演示。

examples.en: The court required a demonstration of the link between the documents.
examples.cn: 法院要求证明这些文件之间的联系。

examples.en: A peaceful demonstration took place outside the town hall.
examples.cn: 市政厅外举行了一场和平示威。

dict_mnemonic.text: “de（完全）+ monstr（展示）+ ation”——把东西彻底摆到众人眼前 → demonstration 示范、证明、示威

root: 拉丁 demonstrare“指出、展示”（de-“完全”+ monstrare“展示”，monstrare 与 monstrum“征兆”、monere“警告”相关）；demonstrat- 词干 + -ion 名词后缀。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses share one act: making something visible to others. What is shown may be a process, a proof, a crowd, a product, a fleet, a feeling or a pilot project.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项共享一个动作：让某物对他人可见。被展示的可以是过程、证明、人群、产品、舰队、情感或试点项目。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand raising an object so that a crowd can see it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手举起物件，让众人看见。

branches.en: HOW IT WORKS: a general demonstration and a classroom experiment both make a process visible step by step.
branches.cn: 如何运作：一般演示与课堂实验，都把过程一步步变得可见。

branches.en: PROOF: evidence is displayed until the conclusion can be seen, not merely heard.
branches.cn: 证明：证据被摆出来，直到结论可见，而不只是可听。

branches.en: POLITICAL AND MILITARY SHOWING: a crowd and a fleet both display strength so that others will draw a conclusion.
branches.cn: 政治与军事展示：人群与舰队都展示力量，使他方得出结论。

branches.en: PROMOTION AND PILOT: a product demo and a demonstration project show something working before others commit.
branches.cn: 推广与试点：产品演示与示范项目都在他人投入前展示某物可行。

branches.en: FEELING: an invisible state is made visible through an act, extending showing from objects to emotions.
branches.cn: 情感：不可见的状态通过行动变得可见，把“展示”从物品延伸到情感。

intro.en: Demonstration is demonstrat- + -ion, on the Latin participle stem of demonstrare. The suffix forms an action or result noun; the de- and monstr- parts are fossilized.
intro.cn: demonstration 是 demonstrare 拉丁分词词干 demonstrat- 加 -ion。后缀构成行为或结果名词；de- 与 monstr- 已凝固。

latinIntro.en: Latin monstrare 'to show' gives monstrum 'portent', monstrare itself and demonstrare 'point out'. English keeps the family in demonstrate, demonstration, demonstrative, monster, monitor, monument, admonish and remonstrate.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 monstrare“展示”产生 monstrum“征兆”、monstrare 本身与 demonstrare“指出”。英语在 demonstrate、demonstration、demonstrative、monster、monitor、monument、admonish、remonstrate 中保留这个词族。

items.meaning: a showing, a proof, or a public protest
items.meaningCN: 展示；证明；公开示威（-ion 表行为或结果）
items.example: The demonstration convinced the committee.
items.exampleCN: 这次演示说服了委员会。

items.meaning: to show clearly; to prove; to protest
items.meaningCN: 清楚展示；证明；示威（de-“完全”+ monstrare“展示”）
items.example: The model demonstrates how heat spreads.
items.exampleCN: 这个模型演示了热如何扩散。

items.meaningCN: 演示者；示威者（-or 表施事）
items.example: The demonstrator explained each step.
items.exampleCN: 演示者解释了每一步。

items.meaning: showing or pointing out; open in showing feeling
items.meaningCN: 指示的；感情外露的（-ive 表性质）
items.example: The demonstrative pronoun points to a specific item.
items.exampleCN: 指示代词指向特定对象。

items.meaning: able to be shown or proved
items.meaningCN: 可证明的；可演示的（-able“可……的”）
items.example: The effect is demonstrable in a simple test.
items.exampleCN: 该效应可通过简单测试证明。

items.meaning: in a way that can be shown
items.meaningCN: 可证明地；明显地（-ly 副词）
items.example: The policy is demonstrably effective.
items.exampleCN: 该政策明显有效。

items.meaningCN: 抗议；反对（re-“回”+ monstrare“展示”）
items.example: The residents remonstrated against the closure.
items.exampleCN: 居民抗议关闭。

items.meaningCN: 监视器；班长（mon-“警告”+ -itor）
items.example: The monitor records the temperature.
items.exampleCN: 监视器记录温度。

items.meaning: a structure that keeps a memory visible
items.meaningCN: 纪念碑；纪念物（mon-“提醒”+ -ment 结果）
items.example: The monument marks the old boundary.
items.exampleCN: 这座纪念碑标记旧边界。
